allowedFields: process ledger ordinal, mode, processId, creationTimeUtc, exitedAtUtc, exitCode and identity receipt binding
lane receipt inputId, superblockId, anonymousLaneId, row counts, laneWallClockMilliseconds and createdAtUtc
input bundle designRegion, seed, gridEdge G, agentCount N, changedCellCount F, topology, graph profile, atomic partitions and context stratum
schedule ordinal and anonymous-lane order; named algorithm identity only after anonymous output is frozen
validator source structure and execution resource observations
prohibitedFields: path quality, effect direction, p-values, formal contrasts, ranking, weighting or winner
timeDecompositionBoundary: Only process wall, inter-process gap, and directly measured inclusive lane-body duration are identifiable. Pure algorithm compute, Unity startup, and exit/finalization are not separately identifiable and no residual may be relabeled as one of them.
